input_recovery.reason: Prior builds absent and no recoverable archived arrays found; durable Vibris metadata retained but earlier payload cache absent.
input_recovery.reference: Fresh mode-3 capture: six nonoverlapping 32-frame windows within three groups, 12 point-windows; 192 accepted native payload files.
input_recovery.moving4: 4243 lights. Both new groups match each other and historical full voxel and leaf identity; all four side-27 windows share the same audited receiver.
input_recovery.ls1: Same two receiver pixels, different 10235-light cohort. Old 3921 lights are a strict subset. First capture rejected at the mode-3 fixture size guard and archived; isolated rebind used all current lamps.

reference.format: Per group: complete compact BFS world-prefix and camera-relative trees, native addresses/physical child slot counts, world/material keys in prefix leaf order, per-light mean RGB/M2 and completeness arrays, audited receivers/window metadata and source/manifest hashes. NumPy NPZ, no pickle.

candidate_definition.base: 32B A; only nonroot cross-world-16^3-brick internal candidate weights replaced
candidate_definition.lookahead: Sum of immediate nonempty children A with native empty slots included in work.
candidate_definition.summaries: Per-K bottom-up Ward minimum increase in weighted squared spatial error; mass-weighted mean, variance trace, leaf 5/12. Equal pair costs break by lexicographic pair of minimum descendant world/material keys.
candidate_definition.kernel: A real-AABB halfspace gate; sum positive component weights mass*clamp((dot(n,mu-x)+sqrt(2*var))/sqrt(max(d2,.25)),.001,1)/max(d2,2*var,.25).
candidate_definition.float32: Float32 summary build/kernel on absolute coordinates, then shared float64 reference PMF propagation. K1 float32 reuses original rounded parent mass. Not GPU instruction/rounding equivalence.

cost_scope: Arrival weighted static source-level counts, per-field maximal positive-probability path. Node bytes include root and selected node rereads; no cache/transaction claims. Summary uses count-bounded component loops; unused capacity consumes allocation but no query loads. Separate breadth worklist and reverse levels, 49 levels capacity; no GPU timing or runtime candidate.

decision: No fixed summary passes all five points. K1 collapses near lights on both sides; K2 is promising on sides and ls1 but worsens top-28 vs prefix A and fails to beat camera A on moving4; K4 improves ls1 most while badly worsening top-28. Retain K2 as a diagnostic, no shader implementation/default change. GPU timing not triggered by this static screening.
